name: Sultan Husayn Bayqara
contribution: The Timurid ruler of Herat from 1469 until May 4, 1506, with a brief interruption in 1470.
image_credit: Attributed to Shah Mozaffar, Golestan of Saadi 1486 · Public domain

checks.lead: Sultan Husayn Bayqara Mirza (Persian: سلطان حسین بایقرا Husayn Bāyqarā; June/July 1438 – 4 May 1506) was the Timurid ruler of Herat from 1469 until May 4, 1506, with a brief interruption in 1470.
